title: Anna and the City Map
text:
Anna is new in the city. She has a map. The map shows the bus station, the park and the school. Anna uses the map to find her way.

Anna also has a timetable for the bus. The bus leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It comes back at five o'clock in the afternoon. Anna takes the bus to school every day.

questions.text: What time does the bus leave in the morning?
Why does Anna use the map?
options: She wants to find her way in the city
She wants to paint a picture
She wants to buy a car
She wants to go to sleep

questions.text: Why does Anna look at the timetable?
options: She wants to know when the bus comes
She wants to visit the park

vocabulary.definition: a picture that shows where places are
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive
a place where buses or trains stop
a public place with grass and trees

paragraph_translations: Anna é nova na cidade. Ela tem um mapa. O mapa mostra a estação de ônibus, o parque e a escola. Anna usa o mapa para encontrar o caminho.
Anna também tem um horário do ônibus. O ônibus sai às oito horas da manhã. Ele volta às cinco horas da tarde. Anna pega o ônibus para ir à escola todos os dias.
